en: The postcard features a beach scene with a camel in a decorative cover standing on sandy ground in the foreground. Behind, two people in swimsuits walk past a parasol made of straw. In the background stands a modernist hotel building labeled 'Астория' (Astoria) with colorful vertical banners. Lush greenery and distant hills can be seen further back. The sky is clear and bright blue.
